name: verifiable-settlement
description: Verifiable event-driven settlement on Hedera: oracle attestation, HCS evidence, a Solidity SettlementRouter, HTS credit and Mirror Node audit. Next.js + Hardhat + a shared TypeScript SDK.

envVars.description: Network the app targets: testnet, mainnet or local. Defaults to testnet when empty.
JSON-RPC relay URL for the selected network. Empty uses the public Hashio endpoint, which is for development and testing only.
Mirror Node REST URL for the selected network. Empty uses the public Hedera Mirror Node.
Server-side operator account ID (0.0.x) that publishes HCS messages and manages HTS. Required by yarn setup.
Private key of the operator account (hex). Required by yarn setup. Secret: never commit it and never expose it to the browser.
Minimum operator balance in HBAR that yarn setup requires. Empty uses the default for the selected network (20 on testnet, 10 on mainnet).
ID (0.0.x) of the HCS topic that receives the settlement evidence. Create it on the selected network with a submitKey equal to the operator key. Required by the HCS publisher.
EVM address of the deployed SettlementRouter. It binds every published attestation (EIP-712 domain) to that deployment. Required by the HCS publisher.
Overall deadline of one HCS publish in milliseconds (1000 to 120000). Empty uses 30000.
Encrypted deployer key written by the account script. Do not fill it manually.
Base URL of the oracle provider.
API key of the oracle provider, when the provider requires one.

steps.label: Create your local environment file
steps.text: Set HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID and HEDERA_OPERATOR_KEY. The file is git-ignored. Never commit keys.
